paper.title: Multi-objective Bandits: Optimizing the Generalized Gini Index

settings.name_in_paper: Multi-objective multi-armed bandit (MO-MAB) with Generalized Gini Index aggregation
settings.out_of_scope_reason: Multi-objective (vector-valued) costs aggregated by the Generalized Gini Index; vector-valued rewards are out of scope in this ontology.
unmapped: D-dimensional vector-valued cost feedback in [0,1]^D, components possibly dependent

learner knows the GGI weights w
settings.definition_quote: a D-objective K-armed bandit problem ($D\ge 2$, $K \ge 2$) is specified by K  real-valued multivariate random variables $\bX_1, \dots , \bX_K$ over $[0,1]^D$. ... \overline{R}^{(T)} = G_{\bw} \left( \bmu \bar{\balpha}^{(T)} \right)  - G_{\bw} \left( \bmu \balpha^{*} \right)

algorithms.name: MO-OGDE (Multi-Objective Online Gradient Descent with Exploration)

symbols.D_obj: number of objectives (dimension of cost vectors)
symbols.L_lip: Lipschitz constant of the GGI function G_w

tuning: projection onto truncated simplex with beta = eta_t

source.label: thm:main
source.quote: With probability at least $1- \delta $: f\Big( \tfrac{1}{T} \sum_{t=1}^T \balpha^{(t)} \Big) - f(\balpha^*) \le 2L\sqrt{\tfrac{6D\ln^3(8DKT^2/\delta)}{T}} for any big enough $T$, where $L$ is the Lipschitz constant of $G_{\bw} (\bx )$.

results.notes: Paper bounds the average (per-round, GGI-of-average) pseudo-regret; multiplied by T here. 'Big enough T' hides instance-dependent constants (g*, a_0, |ext(Delta_K^*)|) from Proposition prop:main. Proof substitutes delta/(8DKT^2) into the algorithm's delta, so T is treated as known. Corollary (regret-presudo) transfers it to the true regret.

source.label: regret-presudo
source.quote: With probability at least $1-\delta$ \vert R^{(T)} - \bar{R}^{(T)}\vert \le L\sqrt{\frac{12D\ln(4(DT+1)/\delta)}{T}}

results.notes: Bound on the difference between regret (GGI of realized average cost) and pseudo-regret; per-round quantity multiplied by T.
